## 🌐 Example GitHub Pages Hosting URLs

When deployed to GitHub Pages (e.g. at `https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/`), datasets can be fetched directly:

- **Restaurants:**
  ```text
  https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/data/food/restaurants.json
  ```
- **Food Items:**
  ```text
  https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/data/food/food-items.json
  ```
- **Restaurant Images:**
  ```text
  https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/data/food/restaurant-images.json
  ```

### Direct Browser Consumption Example

```javascript
// Fetch restaurants dataset
const response = await fetch('https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/data/food/restaurants.json');
const { timestamp, data: restaurants } = await response.json();

console.log(`Dataset last updated at: ${timestamp.updated_at}`);
console.log(`Loaded ${restaurants.length} restaurants`);
```

### Consumption Using [`index.js`](file:///C:/Users/Jeevan%20Achar/Desktop/JSON%20github/index.js)

```javascript
import {
  setBaseUrl,
  getRestaurants,
  getFoodByRestaurantId
} from './index.js';

// Configure base URL for GitHub Pages
setBaseUrl('https://<username>.github.io/<repository>');

// Fetch all restaurants
const restaurants = await getRestaurants();

// Fetch food items for the first restaurant
const menu = await getFoodByRestaurantId(restaurants[0].id);
```
